rawContent: The intersections of racism, sexism, misogynoir, cis-heteropatriarchy, and ableism played out in horrendous ways in Professor Hill's story. They will play out differently for Dr. Blasey. I wish we could acknowledge that continually in the era of #Metoo

Has anyone written about this narrative of Christine Blasey Ford being "used" by the democrats as white supremacist cis-heteropatriarchy in action? Because if so, I'd love to read it. #KavanaughHearings #MeToo

Such brilliant work from many here. Honored my work was included-The trajectories of disabled girls of color tell us much about how identities are criminalized & education withheld from multiply-marginalized girls #DisCrit #DayOfTheGirl #DisabilityJustice #BlackLivesMatter
